no-haircut-5x5.description: Five observed and five executable levels with no haircut.

best-level-25pct-6x6.description: Six observed and executable levels; cap the best-level haircut at 25% of captured depth.

current-six-observed-five-effective.description: Current V-Trade rule: six observed, five executable, one best level capped at 50%.

best-level-50pct-6x6.description: Six observed and executable levels; retain the current 50% best-level cap.

top-two-50pct-7x7.description: Seven observed and executable levels; spread one aggregate 50% cap across the two best levels.

recommendation.rationale: The existing rule violated the 50% retained-depth floor on 7 non-empty sampled side(s); the proposed alternative is the first conservative candidate in the documented preference order with no observed violation.
